question: Does the query-independent, boundary-balanced relation improvement of Field-B accumulate with the independently repaired canonical-negative text-query interface?

candidate.downstream_readout: unchanged frozen VALA kNN10, raw-peak scale selection, per-query min-max/2x-1 remap, fixed 0.6 threshold, selected-only-alpha projection

gate.primary: Field-B plus canonical negatives must exceed the current-field canonical-negative result by at least 0.005 absolute mIoU on Figurines
gate.on_success: run the frozen score-quality ladder and treat boundary-balanced relation learning as an additive Field-F component; expansion requires training query-free checkpoints on other scenes
gate.on_failure: reject the combination as non-additive under the existing readout and move the intervention upstream into capability/readout training; do not tune thresholds or scene parameters

claim_boundary: Only Figurines is tested because it is the only scene with a pre-existing frozen Field-B checkpoint. The candidate is not a cross-scene or benchmark-level claim.
